name: POST /api/public/leads - Public web-form lead capture
description: The marketing site's lead form posts here. This is the ONLY unauthenticated write in LeadFlow and it is deliberate: a prospect filling in the landing-page form holds no session, and requiring one would defeat inbound capture entirely. It is constrained instead - a per-IP rate limit bounds the blast radius, the same validator as the authenticated route runs so no unvalidated field reaches the database or the upstream assertion, and captures land as first_party_declared assertions in the Capture Inbox rather than becoming trusted contacts. Creating a row at a collection root, so it answers 201. QA: no prerequisites; this is a standalone public entry point. AUTO-ROUTING AT INTAKE: the handler routes the lead immediately after persisting it, so the response carries the owner and the started clock rather than a pre-routing snapshot, and `routed` reports whether an owner was assigned. A routing failure does NOT fail the capture - the lead is already durable and appears in the Capture Inbox as unowned for the zero-orphan sweep (POST /api/leads/route-unowned) to pick up.

testCases.name: Capture a lead from the marketing landing page
Reject a submission with a malformed email

errorCases.when: name or email is missing, email is malformed OR longer than 255 characters (the leads.email column width - unbounded input would reach the database and surface as a 500), source is not one of the fourteen channels, or origin_class is not one of the eight origin classes
the calling address exceeded the configured submission window
